findings.evidence: roadmap/TauCetiRoadmap/Chebotarev/README.md:96 lists `hasDirichletDensity_of_squeeze` under the Arithmetic Dirichlet Series contract as “lower bounds for a finite partition can be squeezed to exact densities”, and ArithmeticDirichletSeries/README.md:289 lists “squeeze” among the generic Layer 7.3 calculus; `grep hasDirichletDensity_of_squeeze code/TauCeti` has no hit. `primeIdealZetaSum_biUnion_of_pairwiseDisjoint` (ZetaSumPartition.lean:79) and `hasDirichletDensity_biUnion_finset` (DirichletDensity/Basic.lean:94) are already the generic family forms the proof needs; Squeeze.lean:57–66 only rewrites with `sum_primeIdealZetaSum_frobeniusPrimeSet`, itself a specialisation of the generic partition lemma (ZetaSum.lean:89).
findings.fix: State the general result in `NumberField.Set` (ArithmeticDirichletSeries/DirichletDensity), e.g. `theorem hasDirichletDensity_of_squeeze {ι} {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → Set (HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K))} {d : ι → ℝ} {D : ℝ} (hdisj : (s : Set ι).PairwiseDisjoint f) (hU : HasDirichletDensity (⋃ i ∈ s, f i) D) (hlow : ∀ i ∈ s, IsLowerDirichletDensityBound (f i) (d i)) (hsum : ∑ i ∈ s, d i = D) (i₀) (hi₀ : i₀ ∈ s) : HasDirichletDensity (f i₀) (d i₀)` (plus the upper-bound half), then derive the Frobenius versions in one line from `iUnion_frobeniusPrimeSet`, `pairwise_disjoint_frobeniusPrimeSet`, and `hasDirichletDensity_compl_ramifiedPrimes`. If open PR #4903 already supplies this general form, depend on it rather than landing a fibre-specific duplicate; the deferred collision is not a reason to ship the special case first.
findings.issue: `isUpperDirichletDensityBound_frobeniusPrimeSet_of_forall_isLowerDirichletDensityBound` and `hasDirichletDensity_frobeniusPrimeSet_of_forall_isLowerDirichletDensityBound` are under-generalized: the proof only uses (a) `primeIdealZetaSum` additivity over a finite pairwise-disjoint family (`primeIdealZetaSum_biUnion_of_pairwiseDisjoint`, of which `sum_primeIdealZetaSum_frobeniusPrimeSet` is the specialisation), (b) the union having a Dirichlet density, and (c) the index-generic private lemma `one_sub_sub_le_sum_erase_of_forall_sub_le`. The Chebotarev-specific inputs are only the partition facts `iUnion_frobeniusPrimeSet`/`pairwise_disjoint_frobeniusPrimeSet` and `hasDirichletDensity_compl_ramifiedPrimes`.

summary: The squeeze (upper bound from the other members' lower bounds, hence exact density) is stated only for `frobeniusPrimeSet` although its proof uses nothing beyond a finite pairwise-disjoint family whose union has a known density; the roadmap pins this as the generic `hasDirichletDensity_of_squeeze` that Chebotarev consumes. The abelian corollary and the density-sum lemma are at the right level.
